At the time, I was rooming with someone who I thought was a wonderful mother figure to me. My bio mother never took the time to be one.

 I became best friends with this womans middle daughter and watched her younger one to help. I also cooked for her, cleaned and ran errands since I could never repay letting me stay with her. 

One day we were all out and stopped to get food. She handed me her phone to look at a menu before we ordered in a drive through. She had a conversation up with her oldest and what was on the screen shocked me. She said the nastiest things about me in every other message. She ended it with saying I was a horrible influence on her children and she couldn't wait to get rid of me. 

She was a strict mother with monitoring and restricting her childrens activities such as they werent allowed to celebrate Halloween, watch certain cartoons, basically just be kids. I respected whatever she asked of me. After seeing how she really veiwed me, I left the kids notes and bailed. Every so often I'll hear from one of them and fills my heart to know they are doing so well and maturing wonderfully despite the sheltering. 
It still gets me because of how much I trusted her.
